/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L16: Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L17: [Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L27: Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L31: [Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L34: Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L35: [Image caption: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L66: [Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L69: Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L72: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L75: Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L78: Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a car being worked on in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L17: [Image caption: a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L20: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L21: [Image caption: a photography of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L24: Calvin: That car looks awesome! You're putting in a lot of effort and it's great to see the end result. Keep up the good work. Got any plans for what's next?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L27: Dave: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L36: Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out? 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L37: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car driving down a road]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L16: Dave: Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L20: [Image caption: a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L23: Dave: How long did it take to get everything sorted out? I'm glad it's all taken care of now!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L27: [Image caption: a photography of a man working on a car in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L33: Calvin: That's the mechanic. He knows the stuff and is doing his best to get my car running again.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L36: Dave: That's great to hear! Skilled and knowledgeable people working on your car - are you feeling confident?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L39: Calvin: Feeling way more confident and excited to show off my car! Trusting their expertise.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L78: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! let's keep in touch, take care!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave, long time no see! I just took my Ferrari for a service and it was so stressful. I'm kinda attached to it. Can you relate? What kind of hobbies give you a feeling of being restored?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin, I understand the stress of getting a car serviced. Fixing cars is like therapy for me. Growing up working on cars with my dad, refurbishing them gives me a sense of fulfillment.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L18: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! Must feel great to have a hobby that makes you proud. Remember any good memories from working on cars with your dad?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L21: Dave: Yeah, definitely! I have fond memories of working on cars with my dad as a kid. We spent one summer restoring an old car. It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L31: Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L32: [Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L35: Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, been ages! Guess what? I got picked for a car mod workshop. Gonna get better at it and learn something new! Look at the cars I'm working with right now. 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of a man standing in front of a car on a lift]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L16: Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Congrats on being picked for the car mod workshop. It's a great opportunity to take your skills up a notch. Are there any mods or projects you're excited to work on?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L19: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! This is a dream come true for me, as I've always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L22: Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Pursuing your passion for auto engineering and making a custom car is a great experience. I'm excited to see what you create. Keep it up and have fun every step of the way. What do you think is the most thrilling part of it?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L26: [Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L32: Dave: I've been working on this car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications. Now I'm learning about body modifications. Giving this classic muscle car a modern twist is a challenge but so fun!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L39: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, I wanted a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style. Really happy with it!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-13.md:L67: Calvin: Thanks for the encouragement, Dave. I'll keep working hard and making music. Take care!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L12: Dave: Hey Cal, how's it going? Something cool happened since last we talked - I got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco! So cool to dive into the world of car restoration and see all the different techniques. People were really passionate and dedicated - truly inspiring!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L15: Calvin: Hey Dave! That's awesome! Car workshops sound totally cool and inspiring. Glad you found something that really gets you going.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L43: Dave: Yeah, the project is going great! Here's a pic of the car I'm restoring. It's pretty cool seeing it go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L44: [Image caption: a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L47: Calvin: Wow Dave, that car is going to look amazing when you're done. How long do you think it will take to restore it?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-17.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up? I'm tied up with car stuff lately, yesterday I came back from San Francsico with some great insights and knowledge on car modification that I want to share with you! Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-17.md:L15: Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to hear from you. That's cool! I totally understand the satisfaction you get from fixing cars. It's like you're giving them new life.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-17.md:L18: Dave: Yeah, it's great fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better. It's really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose. Plus, it feels like I'm making a difference when I fix someone's car.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-17.md:L24: Dave: Yeah, it's great! It feels really good to make a difference and see their relief when their car is fixed. Makes me proud!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L19: [Image caption: a photo of a shiny orange car with a hood open]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L22: Dave: Wow, Calvin, that car looks great! Working on cars really helps me relax, it's therapeutic to see them come back to life. I've been working on that Ford Mustang I found in a junkyard - it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L28: Dave: Hey Calvin, check out this photo! I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L29: [Image caption: a photography of a red car parked in a field with other cars]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L33: [Image caption: a photo of a person's hand with dirty hands next to a car]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-21.md:L72: Dave: Yep, Calvin! Together, we can do amazing things if we work together and stay motivated. We got this! Take care and stay well!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! What’s up? Last Friday I went to the car show. I saw some awesome cars and got to mess with car mods! There were so many cool machines around, it was so much fun! Take a look at this beautiful car!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of two men looking at a car engine]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L17: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L20: Dave: Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great! I restored and modified it myself and added a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades. It's got a sweet sound and I'm really proud of how it turned out.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L24: [Image caption: a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L27: Dave: Thanks Calvin! I've spent a lot of time and effort on it. It's not just a hobby, it's a passion. It's like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress. When I was little I'd spend hours in my dad's garage, tinkering with engines - it was like my own sanctuary. Now I'm lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-22.md:L33: Dave: Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L21: Dave: Glad you enjoyed Boston! It's got some great architecture and history. Working on this takes me out of my head and calms me down. Here's a pic of my latest car project.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L22: [Image caption: a photography of a group of people washing a car in a garage]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L25: Calvin: Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L28: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's always been my thing. My dad took me to my first car show when I was 10, and I was wow-ed! I was hooked and wanted to learn more. Now I'm an automotive engineer and it's crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-26.md:L31: Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music. Check this out - a pic of me performing with someone I admire! So amazing!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L36: Dave: Wow, Calvin, imagining how your music affects others must be incredible! Keep up the great work! By the way, I recently started a blog on car mods. It's my way to share my passion with others. Do you have any tips on blogging for me? Just take a look at this beautiful car!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L39: [Image caption: a photography of a car website design]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L45: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's awesome people are checking out my blog and asking me for advice. I recently posted about how I made this car look like a beast, and it was great to hear it inspired others to start their own DIY projects.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L55: Calvin: Yeah Dave, keep doing what you do! Your blog and car mods are inspiring and a great way to help people find their creativity.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L58: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It means a lot that you enjoy my blog. This car mod was a lot of work, but I think it was worth it in the end.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L68: [Image caption: a photography of a blue car parked on a road at night]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L75: [Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black engine and a red hood]
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L78: Calvin: Thanks! Where did you get this car?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L81: Dave: I found it last week, and it was in bad shape, but I saw the potential. I spent ages restoring it.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L84: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that is an awesome job on restoring it! You've got some serious skills!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L134: Dave: Cool, Calvin! Music really helps me focus and be productive. When I'm doing my car stuff, I listen to vinyl to relax and stay on track.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L140: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Music really helps with car work. Keeps me focused and makes it feel great. Even though this player is a bit old, he still gets the job done. Check out its photo!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L155: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Classic rock has had a huge impact on music. Always fun to dig in and find new tunes. Gotta go back to work, see you soon! Take care!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-02.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave, been a few days, so I wanted to let you in on some cool news.  I just got a new car and it's amazing! Finally owning a luxury car was a dream come true and I'm so stoked.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-02.md:L15: Dave: Woohoo, Calvin! Congrats on the new car! How's it driving?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-02.md:L18: Calvin: Nice car! It's an amazing ride - super smooth and real powerful. Like a rockstar behind the wheel! Thanks, man!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-02.md:L25: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-02.md:L28: Dave: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L46: Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L50: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L51: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L34: Dave: I'm so excited, I opened my car shop last week! Invited some friends over to celebrate and it's been amazing. Super stoked to share my passion and help out with folks' rides. It's been incredible so far.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-06.md:L37: Calvin: Way to go, Dave! Congrats on opening your own car shop! Your excitement is contagious. Keep up the great work!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L15: Dave: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L16: [Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L19: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L22: Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L25: Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-11.md:L12: Dave: Hey Cal, been ages since we spoke! Guess what? I just got back from a road trip with my friends - we saw some stunning countryside. It was such a lovely break from the corporate mayhem. Driving on those winding roads, taking in the views, and chatting with my friends recharged me totally - reminds me why I love cars so much. What did you end up doing?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-11.md:L19: [Image caption: a photography of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-11.md:L53: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L53: Calvin: I'll let you know when the podcast will be uploaded. Take care!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L90: [Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L39: Dave: That sounds awesome, Calvin! Live music is the best. I'm sure you're gonna have a blast on tour and make some awesome memories. If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L42: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely take you up on that offer.
